name: Soccsksargen
summary_text: Soccsksargen is the site of the record's most severe trans-related violence finding: on 23 June 2025 in General Santos City, a hooded gunman shot Ali Jejhon Macalintal, a transgender rights activist and radio commentator, several times at the acupuncture clinic she owned and fled on a motorcycle; police said they were investigating whether her history of activism was connected to the killing. Human Rights Watch called it an "apparent targeted killing". The national Commission on Human Rights publicly condemned the killings of two transgender women as "marked by cruelty and impunity" — an official body using the word impunity, the most damning official response language in the national record. No protective ordinance, institutional counterweight or arrest in this killing is documented; the unresolved case is counted within the national series of six killings with arrests in at least three of them, none reported prosecuted to conviction.
